content.value_statement: Presentations and artifacts often need consistent visual styling. Theme Factory provides curated palettes and font pairings for decks, documents, reports, and HTML pages.
actual_capabilities: Shows a bundled 10-page PDF preview of available themes before selection.
Applies one of ten preset themes with documented colors and fonts.
Uses local theme files that list palettes, typography, and best-fit contexts.
Creates a custom theme when preset themes do not fit the artifact.
Supports styling for slides, documents, reports, and HTML pages.
limitations: It does not automatically edit files without an AI tool applying the instructions.
It does not enforce brand guidelines beyond the provided theme specifications.
The bundled PDF preview requires a PDF-capable environment to view.
Custom theme quality depends on the input description and user review.

use_cases.title: Refresh Client Decks
use_cases.description: Apply a consistent palette and font pair to an existing presentation before stakeholder review.

use_cases.title: Launch Campaign Pages
use_cases.description: Style HTML landing pages and campaign assets with a selected visual direction.

use_cases.title: Standardize Reports
use_cases.description: Give reports and strategy documents a polished look without creating a theme from scratch.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Preset Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the theme showcase, ask which theme I prefer, then apply the selected theme to my slide deck.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Theme Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend three themes for this consulting deck and explain the visual tradeoffs before applying one.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Theme to Brand Needs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Tech Innovation theme as a base, but adjust it for a calmer enterprise software audience.

prompt_templates.title: Create and Apply a Custom Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a healthcare report, show the palette and fonts for review, then apply it after approval.

output_examples.input: Apply Ocean Depths to a finance presentation.
output_examples.output: The deck uses Deep Navy backgrounds, Teal accents, Seafoam highlights, Cream text, and DejaVu Sans typography.

output_examples.input: Create a custom theme for a sustainable food brand.
output_examples.output: A nature-focused theme is proposed with fresh green accents, warm neutral backgrounds, readable body text, and review-ready usage notes.

output_examples.input: Style an HTML landing page with Modern Minimalist.
output_examples.output: The page uses a restrained grayscale palette, clear hierarchy, and consistent DejaVu Sans headings and body copy.

best_practices: Show the theme showcase before applying a preset theme.
Get explicit user approval before changing an artifact's visual style.
Check contrast and readability after applying colors and fonts.
anti_patterns: Applying a theme before the user selects or approves it.
Mixing multiple preset themes in one artifact without a clear system.
Using custom colors that weaken contrast or readability.

faq.question: What does Theme Factory do?
faq.answer: It helps apply consistent color palettes and font pairings to slides, documents, reports, and HTML pages.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: It includes ten preset themes with color palettes, fonts, and recommended use cases.

faq.question: Can it create custom themes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a new theme from a user description and present it for review.

faq.question: Does it modify the PDF showcase?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs the assistant to show the PDF for viewing only.

faq.question: What artifacts can it style?
faq.answer: It can guide styling for slide decks, documents, reports, HTML landing pages, and similar artifacts.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
